title: Miles breaks Clark's WNBA rookie scoring record, September 20
dek: Olivia Miles scored 21 points in Minnesota's 101-89 victory over Connecticut on September 20, breaking Caitlin Clark's rookie scoring record. Miles, the No. 2 overall pick in the 2026 draft, swept the Rookie of the Month award and cemented her place among the league's elite first-year talent.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Miles broke the WNBA rookie scoring record in the Lynx's 101-89 win over the Sun on September 20, 2026.
bottom_line: Miles' record-breaking finish on September 20 completes a rookie season in which she won Rookie of the Month unanimously. The Lynx's playoff seeding will be finalized in the days ahead as the regular season concludes.
body: Olivia Miles scored 21 points in the Minnesota Lynx's 101-89 victory over the Connecticut Sun on September 20, breaking Caitlin Clark's WNBA rookie scoring record, according to Yahoo WNBA's reporting.

Miles, the No. 2 overall pick of the 2026 WNBA Draft, has completed her first season as one of the league's most productive newcomers. Per Yahoo WNBA, she swept the Rookie of the Month award across all available months this season, a distinction that underscores her consistency throughout the campaign.

The Lynx's victory moved the team closer to securing the WNBA's top playoff seed, according to Yahoo's reporting. The record-breaking performance arrives during the final stretch of the regular season as Minnesota positions itself for the postseason.

Miles finished her rookie year with a historic scoring total that surpassed the previous standard set by Clark, one of the league's most closely watched recent draft picks. The achievement marks a significant individual milestone in WNBA history and caps a campaign in which Miles has established herself as a foundational piece for Minnesota's future.
